command: if [ -f /certs/localhost.pem ]; then export CADDY_TLS='/certs/localhost.pem /certs/localhost-key.pem'; fi; exec caddy run --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile

dockerfile.do: d=/root/.local/share/mise/downloads; s=/mise-tarball-store; mkdir -p "$d" "$s"; cp -r "$s"/. "$d"/ 2>/dev/null || true; mise install || exit; cd "$d" && for f in */*/*; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; o="$s/$f"; [ -e "$o" ] && continue; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$o")"; t="$(mktemp "$(dirname "$o")/.pXXXXXX")" && cp "$f" "$t" && mv -f "$t" "$o"; done; :

gnu-shell-utils.name: gnu-shell-utils
gnu-shell-utils.do: s=/zypper-store; d=/var/cache/zypp/packages; mkdir -p "$s" "$d"; cp -r "$s"/. "$d"/ 2>/dev/null || true; zypper -n modifyservice --no-refresh --all && sed -i 's|http://|https://|g' /etc/zypp/repos.d/*.repo || exit; zypper -n modifyrepo --keep-packages --all && zypper -n install findutils=4.10.0-160000.2.2 which=2.23-160000.2.2 git-core=2.51.0-160000.1.2 || exit; cd "$d" && for f in */*.rpm */*/*.rpm; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; o="$s/$f"; [ -e "$o" ] && continue; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$o")"; t="$(mktemp "$(dirname "$o")/.pXXXXXX")" && cp "$f" "$t" && mv -f "$t" "$o"; done; zypper -n modifyrepo --no-keep-packages --all || true
